content.value: A universal series motor has resistance of 30 Ω and inductance of 0.5 H. When connected to a 250 V DC supply and loaded to take 0.8 A, it runs at 2000 rpm. Estimate its speed and power factor, when connected to a 250 V, 50 Hz AC supply and loaded to take the same current.
